runner_dissent: The print gave both sides ammunition and the market chose to sell first (-6.5% in two days) then recover. Bulls: every 'wait-and-see' item from 8/7 landed well -- units intact, EPS beat, FCF $8.6B, buybacks ~doubled. Bears: the FY27 guide is the opening chapter of the feared script -- TurboTax +2-3% means the price-for-volume model is exhausting; revenue downshifts to single digits while the +26% profit guide rides margin + buybacks. That is a harvesting story, not a growth story. Framework verdict unchanged: business good, thesis STARTER-grade, but price no longer at starter position. Those who opened 2% at $321.91 are +8% -- hold, don't add, don't chase. Two of three unlocks remain: 10-K ARPC/customers (~early Sept), Investor Day AI monetization (2026-09-17).
